headline: Callahans Passage and Stonecradle Swing Back to Warden Hands
war_summary: Since our last edition the tide has turned: Callahans Passage, credited to the Colonials at the prior filing, now flies Warden colors once more, all ten strongholds recovered after hours of seesaw fighting in which The Latch — the very work our last report saw filled — was again the storm-centre. The two-hour bill there stands at five hundred twenty-two Colonial and four hundred forty-one Warden fallen, though the guns cool from their peak. Stonecradle has flipped as well: The Long Fast changed hands once more and the map now shows nine Warden works, its two-hour toll near fifteen hundred. Weathered Expanse keeps its grim ledger — forty base actions in a day, Necropolis fought over twenty times — while Stlican Shelf burns on about The Old Mourn and Vulpine Watch, firing even as this edition went to press. Fishermans Row, aflame in our last report, has gone quiet these three hours past, as have the Dead Lands' posts, though both roll up heavy casualty lists. Loch Mor and Linn Mercy log mounting losses without a single base action. The ledger now reads two hundred forty-six Colonial works to one hundred eighty-eight Warden, two in ruin at Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf — a marked swing toward the Warden column. It is the war's one-hundred-fortieth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
